summary: Wenatchee NF, Chelan County, WA ground site: an L-4 cab below the ridgetop, staffed in 1933, abandoned 1941 and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab built below the ridgetop, not a tower
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1941 per FFLOS and FireLookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone. No source describes what remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field and FireLookout.com give 1931; the register's description gives 1934 for the L-4 cab below the ridgetop. A 1932 newspaper report of new stations on Lorraine peak falls between the two. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.
The brief's status 'gone' is supported by the Forest Fire Lookout Association listing, which says Gone. The register and FireLookout.com say only that the cab was abandoned in 1941.

notes_for_editor: Ground cab, not a tower, so no height is recorded. Confidence is medium: the existence, location, 1941 abandonment and gone status agree across sources, but the build year conflicts (1931 vs 1934) and no source describes remains or public access. The 'Built 1931' quote spans a line break in the register text. Staffing rests on the 1933 Leavenworth Echo item and FireLookout.com; no later staffing was found. The brief's 1931 build event is supported by two sources but the register's own description says 1934.
